newsitem.title: UK: Avg discount rate at UK 91-day bill tender 6.7810%.
newsitem.headline: Avg discount rate at UK 91-day bill tender 6.7810%.

text.p: The average rate of discount at the weekly tender of 91-day UK Treasury bills rose to 6.7810 percent from 6.7800 last week, the Bank of England said on Friday.
The 200 million stg offer attracted bids of 1.126 billion stg. The pro rata price was 98.305.
The Bank also auctioned 300 million stg of 28-day bills at an average rate of discount of 6.8763 percent, up from 6.8438 percent last week.
For those, it received bids of 1.345 billion stg. The pro-rata price was 99.47.
Next week 200 million stg of 91-day bills will be on offer as well as 300 million stg of 28-day bills.
